headline: Hyundai Motor Q3 Operating Profit Beats Estimates; Shares Advance
summary: Hyundai Motor reported third-quarter operating profit that surpassed market forecasts, driving gains in the automaker's shares.
why: Hyundai Motor is one of the world's largest automotive groups; its operating margins reflect consumer demand for higher-margin SUVs and hybrid vehicles.

impacts.name: Hyundai Motor
impacts.why: Operating earnings beat consensus expectations, leading investors to bid up shares.

why_moved: Hyundai Motor shares rose after third-quarter operating profit beat market estimates.
